name: io.github.JlMoreno00/sabor
title: Sabor
description: Cooking MCP server for Mealie: search, create and edit recipes, plan meals, manage shopping lists.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP endpoint on loopback only.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to register: core, import, shopping_sync, pricing and legacy_* sets. Empty registers discovery only; unknown names fail startup.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Recipe backend: sqlite or mealie. Unset selects mealie when MEALIE_BASE_URL is non-empty, otherwise sqlite.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_STORE_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite recipe database path; parent directories are created at startup. Persist and back up its data volume.

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Mealie instance, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:9925 from Docker or http://mealie:9000 on a shared Compose network. Required by the core recipe, meal plan and shopping tools.

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Mealie API token (Mealie > User profile > API tokens), sent as a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for text import and portable video import, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name for SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL; required when that endpoint is set.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for SABOR_LLM_BASE_URL; required for non-localhost endpoints.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_VIDEO_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Video import provider: gemini_native or openai_compatible. Unset uses Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set, otherwise the OpenAI-compatible LLM.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Google Gemini API key for native video recipe extraction.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_RECIPE_GEMINI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Gemini model used for native video extraction.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_RECIPE_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.description: Scratch directory for downloaded video media.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bring! account email for the shopping_sync toolset; set together with BRING_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bring! account password; set together with BRING_EMAIL.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_CATALOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory with the Bring! item catalog; unset searches the installed bring-api package data.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_MERCADONA_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in Mercadona pricing provider for the pricing toolset (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: MERCADONA_WAREHOUSE
environmentVariables.description: Mercadona warehouse code used for prices, e.g. mad1 or bcn1.

environmentVariables.name: SPOONACULAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Legacy, optional: key for the legacy_spoonacular toolset and the experimental nutrition provider. Not needed for the default toolsets.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Markdown file used by the legacy_memory toolset for preferences and pantry notes.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NORMALIZE_IMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Normalize ingredients of successful imports through Mealie (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_INGREDIENT_PARSER
environmentVariables.description: Mealie ingredient parser used for normalization (sent to Mealie).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NORMALIZE_CONFIDENCE
environmentVariables.description: Minimum parser confidence to accept a normalized ingredient (0-1).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable the experimental legacy nutrition service (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path for the nutrition service.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Reported nutrition provider selector.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_MIN_PROFILE_CONFIDENCE
environmentVariables.description: Minimum confidence to accept a nutrition food profile (0-1).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_MIN_PUBLISH_COVERAGE
environmentVariables.description: Minimum ingredient coverage required to publish nutrition to Mealie (0-1).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_MIN_PUBLISH_CONFIDENCE
environmentVariables.description: Minimum confidence required to publish nutrition to Mealie (0-1).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_PUBLISH_ESTIMATES
environmentVariables.description: Allow publishing estimated nutrition values (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_PROFILE_TTL_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a cached nutrition profile stays fresh.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_NOT_FOUND_TTL_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a provider "not found" result is cached.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_SOURCE_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of recipe ingredient text for nutrition matching.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_DEFAULT_CUP_ML
environmentVariables.description: Millilitres assumed for one cup.

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_AUTO_ON_IMPORT
environmentVariables.description: Calculate nutrition after a successful import (true/false).

environmentVariables.name: SABOR_NUTRITION_AUTO_PUBLISH
environmentVariables.description: Publish the automatic import calculation to Mealie (true/false).
